title: The Arms Act, 1959
sourceNote: Official India Code. The Act regulates acquisition, possession, manufacture, sale, transfer, import and export of arms and ammunition.

title: The Arms Rules, 2016
sourceNote: Official India Code / Government of India. The 2016 Rules replaced the Arms Rules, 1962 and prescribe licensing, manufacture, possession, sale, transfer and related procedures under the Arms Act, 1959.

title: The Uttar Pradesh Gangsters and Anti-Social Activities (Prevention) Act, 1986
titleHi: उत्तर प्रदेश गिरोहबन्द और समाज विरोधी क्रियाकलाप (निवारण) अधिनियम, 1986
sourceNote: Official India Code. The Act provides the statutory framework for prevention and prosecution of specified gang-related and anti-social activities in Uttar Pradesh.

title: The Uttar Pradesh Control of Goondas Act, 1970
sourceNote: Official India Code. The Act provides for preventive action and control measures against persons falling within its statutory definition of 'goonda'.

title: The Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
titleHi: अनुसूचित जातियां और अनुसूचित जनजातियां (अत्याचार निवारण) अधिनियम, 1989
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
sourceNote: Official India Code. The current statutory framework incorporates major amendments including the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Amendment Act, 2015 and the 2018 amendment legislation.

title: The Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Rules, 1995
titleHi: अनुसूचित जातियां और अनुसूचित जनजातियां (अत्याचार निवारण) नियम, 1995
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
sourceNote: Official India Code. The Rules implement the 1989 Act; the official text incorporates the 2016 amendment framework.

title: The Protection of Civil Rights Act, 1955
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
sourceNote: Official India Code. The Act was originally enacted as the Untouchability (Offences) Act, 1955 and was renamed the Protection of Civil Rights Act, 1955 in 1976.
